disposition_mapping.rationale: The employee-initiated submission survives unchanged in substance and actor (satisfying EXR-R-10 and the actor-separation basis for EXR-R-03), but the function is restructured to capture receipts digitally at the point of entry rather than relying on later manual handling. The receipt-threshold evidence requirement (EXR-R-01) travels intact as a hard input to this step; no automation may waive it.

The council converged, over round 2, on keeping extraction as its own independently inspectable, independently logged stage rather than folding it into submission or policy screening: collapsing it would make it impossible to tell whether a disputed or erroneous line originated in what the employee submitted or in what the extraction model inferred, which matters directly for KB-05's error-correction principle and for employee disputes. It is explicitly unconstrained_by_design, so the function is reshaped from manual AP-analyst re-keying into an automated agent with a logged confidence score and a staffed exception queue for low-confidence or degraded-image cases.

EXR-R-07 requires this function to survive and EXR-R-02 requires it to precede approval; both hold, with T3 preceding T4. The mechanical limit/category/per-diem checks are automated into a deterministic rules engine, but flagged lines still route to a human for disposition before the claim proceeds, preserving an auditable rule basis for every rejection (KB-05) and keeping the step distinct from approval so the ordering requirement is substantive, not cosmetic.

Six of the seven council positions (pragmatist, finance_domain, hitl_designer, agentic_architect, accounting_standards, emerging_economy) converged against the maximalist proposal to auto-clear policy-compliant claims under a delegation-of-authority ruleset. The decisive point, made independently by several members, is that manager approval testifies to business appropriateness - a judgment the policy engine in T3 cannot make because it has no access to business context - and that a 'no flags raised, therefore approved' outcome is simply T3's output restated, not an independent second act. Satisfying EXR-R-08 is read here as an affirmative human decision on every claim, not merely a locatable approval authority; actor separation from T1 (EXR-R-03) is preserved by construction since the actors differ.

Unconstrained_by_design, so the boundary is negotiable, but the function is not eliminated: finance's judgment on coding ambiguity (capex/opex, VAT, intercompany recharge) cannot be resolved by a posting rules engine, which validates structure but does not adjudicate ambiguity. The council converged on narrowing review from universal to risk-based (flags, materiality, ambiguous coding) plus a periodic sample of the auto-cleared population as a standing detective control, since removing routine review entirely would leave no mechanism to catch a systematically miscalibrated upstream engine. This review is kept as a distinct step that gates posting rather than merging into the posting engine, so that a flagged claim's human disposition is visible and completed before the ledger entry is made.

EXR-R-04 and EXR-R-05 require posting to keep consuming the expense transaction date and the transaction-date exchange rate; T6 preserves both as explicit, non-substitutable inputs, satisfying KB-01's accrual basis and KB-07's spot-rate recognition. Posting mechanics (coding, cost-centre mapping, FX translation) are automated as deterministic computation, not estimation, but the engine halts and escalates to a GL accountant on ambiguous mapping, missing rates, or a locked period (KB-03 cutoff discipline), with periodic sampling to catch systemic misconfiguration - this is automation of mechanics, not removal of accountability for exceptions.

EXR-R-09 requires reimbursement to survive and EXR-R-06 requires approval to precede it; both hold, since T4 and T6 precede T7 and the payment agent cannot fire without a precondition-checked approval and posting record. The council rejected building a new disbursement rail (pragmatist, agentic_architect) in favour of automating execution on the existing, already-hardened AP payment-run infrastructure, while accommodating configurable non-bank rails as a deployment option (emerging_economy) without that being a universal redesign requirement. Posting (recognition) and payment (derecognition) are kept as separately triggered, separately timestamped events per KB-11, consistent with accounting_standards' objection to fusing them into one undifferentiated system event.

Explicitly unconstrained_by_design and carrying no recognition, measurement or evidential content. The council agreed this becomes a system-triggered by-product of settlement rather than a separately staffed AP-analyst task, with a low-connectivity-resilient channel default (e.g. SMS) rather than an assumption of universal smartphone/email access.

steps.description: The employee originates the claim through a self-service portal or mobile app that photographs receipts at the point of entry. The employee remains the sole accountable actor for the assertion of entitlement; no agent or card-feed process may generate or submit a claim on the employee's behalf. Receipts for claim lines above the receipt threshold are still mandatory before the claim can proceed.
inputs: Receipts for claim lines above the receipt threshold
steps.name: Claim submission with digital capture
outputs: Submitted expense claim with captured receipt images

steps.description: An extraction agent (OCR/line-item parsing) converts captured receipt images and claim text into a structured claim record, logging model version and a confidence score per field, with a pointer back to the source image so the record stays attributable. Low-confidence fields and unparseable receipts (illegible, vernacular-script, degraded images) route to an AP analyst exception queue for manual correction, which is itself logged as a supervised override rather than a silent edit. This function is kept as its own stage, distinct from submission and from policy screening, so that an error can later be traced to what the employee submitted versus what the extraction engine inferred.
inputs: Submitted expense claim with captured receipt images
steps.name: Automated extraction with exception queue
outputs: Structured claim record with extraction provenance (model version, confidence score, source-image link)

steps.description: A deterministic rules engine evaluates every claim line against expense policy limits, categories and per-diem rates, citing the specific rule for any flag. Flagged lines (over-limit, miscategorised, missing receipt above threshold, suspected duplicate, split personal/business charges) route to a named AP analyst (or finance reviewer for higher-value/ambiguous flags) for disposition - resolved, escalated or rejected with reason - before the claim can proceed. This remains a distinct, auditable gate and completes in full before the claim reaches line manager approval.
steps.name: Automated policy compliance screening with exception adjudication
outputs: Policy-checked claim with flag disposition trail

steps.description: The claimant's line manager reviews and affirmatively approves or rejects every claim, regardless of whether it is policy-clean. The manager's decision testifies to business appropriateness (was this expenditure legitimate for this employee's role, pattern-consistent, necessary), a judgment no policy engine can make and which is not satisfied by a default 'no flags raised, therefore approved' outcome. The presentation may be streamlined - flagged lines surfaced prominently - but the manager retains full sight of the whole claim and must take an action on it; no ruleset may auto-approve on the manager's behalf. Where the manager is also the claimant, approval forces escalation to the next-level approver.
steps.name: Line manager approval

steps.description: Finance review is scoped to claims carrying unresolved policy flags, claims above a materiality threshold, claims with ambiguous GL coding (capex/opex, VAT recoverability, intercompany recharge), and a periodic statistical sample of fully clean, auto-cleared claims. This review completes, and its exceptions are resolved, before the claim's figures are recognised in the GL - it is a gate on posting, not a clean-up performed after the fact. The sampling function is the standing detective control that catches a systematically miscalibrated policy or extraction engine before it compounds across a reporting period.
steps.name: Risk-based finance review with periodic sampling

steps.actor: System (posting agent) / GL accountant (exception and sampling)
steps.description: A posting agent applies chart-of-accounts mapping, cost-centre assignment and FX translation, posting automatically when mapping is unambiguous and the transaction-date rate is available. It consumes the expense transaction date and the transaction-date exchange rate as explicit, non-substitutable inputs, posts in the period the expense was incurred (generating an accrual if that period is closed), and halts and escalates to a GL accountant rather than posting around a locked period or against a stale/missing rate. The GL accountant also performs periodic sampling of automated postings to catch systemic misconfiguration. Every automated posting is logged with its rate source and timestamp.
steps.name: Automated posting with GL accountant exception handling

steps.actor: System (payment agent) / AP analyst (batch exception ownership)
steps.description: A payment agent batches the approved, posted claim into the existing AP payment run and executes disbursement using existing, hardened banking controls (with mobile-money or other non-bank rails configurable where the deployment context requires it). The agent cannot fire until an approval record from T4 and a posting confirmation from T6 both exist, keeping recognition (posting) and derecognition (payment) as two separately timestamped, separately triggered events. An AP analyst owns the batch and its exceptions (failed bank validations, duplicate-payment flags, unusually large amounts) rather than touching every payment individually. On settlement, a system-triggered notification (defaulting to a low-connectivity-resilient channel such as SMS where needed) informs the employee automatically; on failure, a reason code is issued instead.
steps.name: Automated reimbursement and notification via AP payment run
